motion.replayGuarantee: Same v1 config/seed/explicit integer tick sequence and ordered normalized event log yields identical state and legacy logical glyph cells in tested runtime across 1/2/5 presentation grouping; not arbitrary live mouse recordings or cross-platform pixels.

interaction.pointer: CSS-rect normalization to [-1,1], coalesced latest target; reachable marker clamped to pad and maxDistance. Does not trigger or redirect a latched leap.
interaction.keyboard: Native Leap/Pause/Reset/target/static-pose controls; focused canvas arrows target, Enter/Space leap, Escape clear; no global interception.
interaction.touch: Tap release within12CSSpx triggers; any drag excursion, cancel/leave/lost capture clears gesture. Pan-y preserves scrolling. Real device acceptance pending.
interaction.precedence: Validate whole batch, next tick and increasing seq; first eligible leap latches. Later busy leaps ignored without queue. Pause/reduced/hidden/offscreen/zero compose. Reduced motion permits deliberate static alternatives only.

accessibility.description: A stylized ASCII frog with a squat torso, large eyes, folded rear legs and attached forelimbs aims then deliberately leaps.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Static poster; Leap cycles rest/crouch/airborne/landed without travel/ticks/RAF. Live preference change honored; pointer/Play cannot override.
accessibility.pause: Exact committed pose freezes including gaze; reset/config preserves pause. Hidden/offscreen/zero/undersized independently suspend. Idempotent disposal releases ownership.
accessibility.liveRegion: Sparse deliberate action status; glyph/frame content not auto-announced.
